name: BlogNav
description: Blog article sub-navigation: a back-to-articles action plus previous/next controls for stepping through the article sequence.

currentPath.description:
Active route used to compute the prev/next disabled state. Defaults to the
current pathname from the router; stories and tests override it to show a
given position in the article sequence.

pages.description: Ordered article paths. Defaults to the bundled legacy sequence.

onNavigate.description: Host navigation callback. Defaults to the configured navigation runtime.

disabled.description: Disables every action while host navigation is pending.

ariaRequirements: Wrapped in a nav landmark labelled via aria-label (blogNavLabel)
a11y.reviewedNote: 2026-07-16 beta->stable: production NextBlogNav now composes BlogNav with live post metadata; required-story AT snapshots and Chromium forced-colors were recaptured after the host-driven pages/navigation API landed.

forbiddenUse: Hardcode a second article sequence in an application wrapper; pass the live ordered pages collection.
Use BlogNav as site-wide navigation; use SiteHeader or NavLink instead.
dense: Blog article sub-navigation: back-to-articles plus prev/next stepping for article pages

usage.description: Sub-navigation for blog articles. Renders a back-to-articles action and previous/next controls that step through the article sequence, disabling the edges (and both when the route is not an article). Blog chrome; for site-wide nav use SiteHeader/NavLink.

bestPractices.description: Pass the published article sequence from the host's content manifest.
Set disabled during pending host navigation to prevent duplicate requests.
Do not show adjacent controls when the current route is absent from pages; both controls intentionally disable.

anatomy.name: Adjacent actions
anatomy.description: Previous and next article controls with edge-state disabling.
